guide_target.label: 二重影（2000年オリジナルPC版）

sources.title: 二重影 攻略 by 愚者の館（アーカイブ）
sources.notes: Primary Set A. Directly inspected complete Japanese walkthrough for ケロQ 二重影. It explicitly reports 確認バージョン「修正なし」 and 状況「完了（ＣＧ・回想１００％）」, and contains separate 桔梗・命・楓玲 sections with movement/action sequences, timed choices, saves, heroine bad ends, main heroine ends, 北条 END, 舞 BAD END, and イルスイ BAD END.

sources.title: 二重影攻略 - BIGLOBE
sources.notes: Primary Set B. Independent directly inspected 12-day Japanese walkthrough. It documents the day-by-day navigation/action flow, heroine-affection choices (including 桔梗・命・楓玲 and 紗枝), the day-11 final quiz, heroine selection by highest affection, the 陵辱 vs ハッピー ending branch, and the Il-Sui rescue/failure sequence. Its route presentation differs substantially from SagaoZ, providing an independent cross-check rather than a derivative copy.

sources.title: ゲーム攻略＿二重影 (Destiny-Tiar / Infoseek mirror)
sources.notes: Supplementary independent candidate. Search indexing shows three攻略 heroines (楓玲・命・桔梗), common progress through day 9, and route splits on days 9/11, but direct page inspection times out. Retained only as corroborative discovery; it is not needed for the accepted A/B gate.

sources.title: 二重影攻略館 7～12日目
sources.notes: Supplementary independent source surfaced by current search. Search-indexed content independently documents the late-game heroine/Jubei happy-end choice and the Il-Sui bad-end failure sequence. Direct page open currently returns 403, so it is supplementary rather than a primary verification set.

sources.title: PCゲーム攻略/は行/ふ/二重影 - ゲーム攻略まとめwiki
sources.notes: Supplementary derivative source only. Directly inspectable, but it attributes its source/save-data basis to SAGAOZ and reproduces the SagaoZ walkthrough structure/text; therefore it is not used as an independent verification set.
